newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Terexko sells hotels, travel units.
newsitem.headline: Terexko sells hotels, travel units.

text.p: Restaurant to hotels company Terexko Ltd said on Friday that it would sell hotels unit Y Group and its travel agency business back to the vendors of the Y Group from 21.77 million rand with effect from April 25.
In addition to the payment, the vendors have warranted that Terexko will earn a net profit before tax of 3.23 million rand for the period it held the Y Group.
Terexko said that the sale follows an earlier cautionary dated May 11 and comes in the wake of a dispute between the vendors and Terexko.
Terexko said it will consider future investments in the hotel industry.
At the same time Terexko said construction of a Villamoura restaurant in Cape Town had begun, in line with its objective of taking the business nationally. The restaurant should open in December.
A new restaurant brand had been conceptualised, the Cafe Ba Ba Reeba, with the first outlet opening in August in Cape Town after which six more will be built a 1998.

On its property portfolio, Terexko said that it had entered into agreement with Global Resorts SA Ltd whereby that group has been granted an option to buy the properties held by WTC Properties (Pty) Ltd, together with all furniture and equipment for 154 million rand.
As these transactions could have an impact on Terexko's shares, shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their share dealings.
